<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Microservices-only AutoPay subscription-management proxy. Connect terminates merchant authentication using private API key, Basic auth, or Keycloak JWT, resolves the merchant tenant, forwards the request to AutoPay with Merchant-Id, and returns AutoPay's response body and status to the merchant.

Cancels a subscription through AutoPay and records the merchant as the initiator upstream.
**`Idempotency-Key` is required** (a UUID v4). Without it Connect returns `400` before calling AutoPay.

- Retrying with the same key and the same body returns the same result and does not cancel twice. Use this after a timeout.
- The same key with a different body returns `409` with `code: idempotency_conflict`. Use a new key for a new request.

An unknown `mode` is rejected by Connect with `400`. Canceling a subscription that has already ended returns `422` with `code: invalid_transition`.

Only this endpoint can cancel immediately. A customer who cancels from the self-service page always cancels at the end of the period. `cancellation_initiator` records who last scheduled a cancellation and is not cleared if the customer undoes it, so read `cancel_at_period_end` and `status` to know whether a cancellation is pending.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel/' \\\n--header 'Idempotency-Key: <uuid>' \\\n--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY' \\\n--data '{\n  \"mode\": \"immediate\"\n}'"}</pre>
